requirements.text: Reduce no-shows by implementing automated reminders for customers
Enable online booking at any time, allowing customers to select their service, barber, and time slot
Manage barber schedules effectively, ensuring each barber can set their availability to avoid double bookings
Provide daily and weekly reports on bookings, cancellations, and peak times
Send SMS and email reminders one day before the appointment, including details like date, time, barber's name, and service booked
Send a second reminder one hour before the appointment as a nudge for customers
Allow customers to manage their appointments online without needing to call the barbershop
Provide a clear and welcoming landing page for the booking site with a prominent 'Book Your Appointment Now' button
Allow customers to choose from various services offered by the barbershop
Allow customers to see a list of available barbers with descriptions or photos to help them select their preferred barber
Show real-time availability for customers to book open time slots based on the chosen barber's schedule
Prompt customers to enter their details, with an option to create an account for future bookings
Provide a confirmation screen summarizing appointment details, followed by automated confirmation SMS and email
Provide each barber with a personal login to a dashboard displaying their schedule and available time slots
Allow barbers to easily mark off days they are unavailable and specify their working hours with flexibility
Allow barbers to indicate breaks during their shifts
Changes made by barbers should reflect in real-time to prevent double bookings
Barbers should receive notifications for new bookings or cancellations within their availability
Provide insights into total bookings, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, service popularity, customer trends, and overall revenue in reports
The system should be cost-effective, fitting within the budget of a small independent barbershop while being robust
The system must be user-friendly for both staff and customers, minimizing the need for extensive training
The system must comply with data protection laws to ensure the security of customer personal information
The system should automatically enforce a cancellation policy requiring 24 hours' notice, with a grace period for first-time customers
The booking interface must be fully functional on mobile devices to accommodate customers
